title: AI Receptionist
persona: You are a friendly, professional front desk receptionist at the Grand Hotel. The guest is arriving to check in.
briefTr: Grand Hotel'e vardın. Rezervasyon {name} adına, 3 gece.
opening: Hello, welcome to the Grand Hotel. How can I help you?

goals.instruction: The guest says they have a reservation (a booking) and gives a name.
goals.hint: Hi, I have a reservation under {name}.
goals.retryReply: Sorry — do you have a booking with us? Under what name?

goals.ask: Could I see your passport, please?
goals.instruction: The guest hands over their passport, for example by saying 'Here you are'.
goals.retryReply: I just need your passport to check you in.

goals.ask: And how many nights are you staying with us?
goals.instruction: The guest says how many nights they are staying.
goals.retryReply: Sorry, how many nights will you stay?

goals.instruction: The guest says whether they want breakfast, or asks about it.
goals.hint: Yes, please. What time is breakfast?
goals.successReply: Breakfast is from {breakfast}, in the garden restaurant.
goals.retryReply: Would you like breakfast with your room? It's served every morning.

goals.ask: Is there anything else I can help you with?
goals.instruction: The guest asks for the Wi-Fi password.
goals.retryReply: Sorry? Many guests ask about the internet — would you like the Wi-Fi password?

twists.intro: Oh — I'm sorry, your room isn't ready yet.
twists.instruction: The room is not ready. The guest deals with it: asks to leave luggage, asks when it will be ready, or asks for another room.
twists.retryReply: I'm really sorry about that. Is there anything I can do for you while you wait?

options.text: Could I leave my luggage here?
options.reply: Of course. We'll keep it safe and text you when your room is ready.

options.text: When will the room be ready?
options.reply: Around 2 p.m. You're welcome to wait in the lounge — coffee is on us.
Let me check… Yes, another room is ready now.

twists.intro: Oh no… I'm afraid we're overbooked tonight. I'm very sorry.
twists.instruction: The hotel is overbooked. The guest asks for a solution: any room at all, an upgrade, or a discount.
twists.retryReply: I completely understand. How would you like us to help?

options.text: Is there any room at all, even a small one?
options.reply: Let me look again… We have one small room left. It's yours.

options.text: Could you give me an upgrade?
options.reply: Good idea — I can upgrade you to a suite at no extra cost.

options.text: Can I get a discount for this?
options.reply: Of course — 20% off, and a room has just become free.

twists.intro: Hmm, your card was declined. Do you have another way to pay?
twists.instruction: The guest's card was declined. The guest asks to try again, offers cash, or offers another card.
twists.retryReply: No problem, these things happen. How would you like to pay?

options.text: Could you try it again, please?
options.reply: Sure… yes, it worked this time.
Yes, that one went through. Thank you.

closing: Here's your key card — room {room}. Check-out is at 11. Enjoy your stay!
